nodes.name: Alert dispatch webhook
nodes.notes: Generic, reusable sub-workflow: every other workflow in this library that needs to raise an internal alert (W1.1/W1.2's generation-failure alert, W0.1/every workflow's errorWorkflow setting) should call THIS webhook rather than hitting Slack/SMS directly - one place to change delivery logic. Body contract: {severity: 'info'|'warning'|'critical', source: string (which workflow/step raised it), message: string}. Not itself blocked on an undecided threshold - W2.4's 'documented only' status in the previous version of this catalog was about WHAT triggers an alert (thresholds like 'high-value lead', 'overdue'), not the dispatch mechanism itself, which needed no such decision.

nodes.name: Critical?
nodes.notes: ASSUMED routing rule, not specified by the brief: 'critical' goes to Slack AND SMS, 'warning'/'info' go to Slack only. Reasonable default (SMS for urgent-enough-to-interrupt, Slack for everything worth a record), but worth confirming - the brief just says 'Slack/SMS via n8n' without a routing rule between them.

nodes.name: Send to Slack
nodes.notes: GAP WORTH FLAGGING DIRECTLY, not just in this comment: Slack isn't in 02 - Launch Checklist's account list at all - the brief assumes a Slack workspace/incoming-webhook exists without listing it as something to create or gather a credential for. Either it's assumed already in place from other Orbit AI ops, or this is a genuine gap in the checklist worth asking about before go-live.

nodes.name: Send SMS (critical only)
nodes.notes: SAME GAP AS SLACK, more so: no SMS provider (Twilio or otherwise) appears ANYWHERE in 02 - Launch Checklist - not even as a deferred/later item the way Telnyx and Documenso are. If SMS alerts are actually wanted for go-live, a provider account needs adding to the credential set; until then this stays a named placeholder with no real vendor decided, not just no key yet.
